description: Compare three loans side by side — monthly payment, total interest and total cost — with the cheapest option highlighted.

faqs.a: The cheapest loan is the one with the lowest total cost (principal plus all interest). A lower monthly payment does not always mean a cheaper loan.
Only principal and interest are compared. Origination fees, points and other charges are not included unless you add them to the loan amount.
faqs.q: Are fees included in the comparison?

faqs.a: A longer term lowers the monthly payment but usually increases total interest. This table lets you see both effects at once.
faqs.q: Why would a longer term be more expensive?

howto: Enter amount, rate and term (years) for each of the three loans.
Compare monthly payment, total interest and total cost in the table.
Pick the loan highlighted as the cheapest overall.
title: Loan Comparison Calculator
